▌ Introduction
Dear Sir / Madam,
We wish to begin by thanking you for providing us this opportunity to provide you the IT Infra & Security assessment.
There are over 6.5 lakh SME companies across India comprising those falling under 10 Cr to 1000 Cr business turnover per annum; most of whom need 'seamless business operations' while they live with organically grown IT infra. The problems associated with these organically grown IT infra are: outdated technologies, non-resilient networks, compromised data network securities etc. According to classified reports, the majority of these organizations' data are in a vulnerable state resulting in undesired data leaks, data losses or hacks.
ITCraft is on a mission to assist these SMEs build resilient IT infra & robust data network securities 'Business continuity' IT. As an immediate first step ITCraft has taken up a task of assisting 10,000 SMEs across India and under this, we are pleased to take up your organization's cause too.
ITCraft benefits Indian SMBs through 5 core, engineered specializations:
Design & build 'business continuity enabled IT infra'
Protect or Secure 'confidential data' at different levels
Provide strong monitoring & managed services through SOC & NOC
Boost productivity through relevant AI tools
Reduce Capex and recurring costs
ITCraft is pleased to share this assessment report which can be updated with the next level of information & should work as a base guide for further implementation process.
Thanking you and assuring you of our best attention at all times.
Warm regards,
ITCraft
